title: TIA bench report
description: Evidence of one end-to-end bench run (epic #142): an agent uses the MCP and the harness skills against TIA Portal V21 and the S7-1200 bench. The runner writes it to tests/bench/out/<UTC stamp>/report.json; the capability coverage check (#147) and the beta-to-stable release gate (#148) read it. It is bound to the exact build under test through build.installerSha256. verdict `incomplete` means the run stopped at a human gate (G1 trust dialog, G3 download, G4 online/upload) that was not approved in that run; only `pass` gates a promotion. Validated by scripts/bench-report.mjs, a zero-dependency validator for the subset of Draft 2020-12 used here.

appVersion.description: The app version, for a beta the full X.Y.Z-beta.N.

installerSha256.description: SHA-256 of the installer that was installed through the updater; null for a source build, which can never gate a promotion.

toolsExercised.description: Every tia_* tool the run called.

skillsExercised.description: Every harness skill the run used (a directory under skills/).

notes.description: Runner remarks, for example why a run is incomplete.

commit.description: A git commit SHA, abbreviated or full, lower case.

scenario.description: The result of one scenario of tests/bench/scenarios/<id>/.

step.description: One tool or skill call of the run. Fields beyond the ones below are allowed.

handoff.description: A human gate the run reached. A run that was approved carries approvedBy and resumedAt; one that stopped there does not. G5 (safety/F) is never in scope. Fields beyond the ones below are allowed.

gate.description: The product's gate. G3 download, G4 online or station upload, G1 trust dialog, G6 credentials, G7 network scan; `unknown` for a gate name this schema does not know yet.

kind.description: The product's own gate name, for example trust_dialog, download_approval, go_online, station_upload.

check.description: One check of the scenario's expect.json as run, plus the outcome. Fields beyond the ones below are the check's own (value, changes, withinMs, ...).
